targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM halts WHERE bot_id='copy_teamfollow' AND resumed_at IS NULL) THEN 'HALTED' ELSE 'running' END AS state
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='open' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='teamfollow'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='teamfollow'
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(pnl_usd)::numeric, 2), 0) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='teamfollow'

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_usd > 0)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) * 100)::numeric, 1) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='teamfollow'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM halts WHERE bot_id='copy_teamfollow' AND halted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT exit_at AS time, SUM(pnl_usd) OVER (ORDER BY exit_at) AS pnl_cum FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND exit_at IS NOT NULL AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='teamfollow' ORDER BY exit_at
SELECT exit_at AS time, pnl_pct AS value FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND exit_at IS NOT NULL AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='teamfollow' ORDER BY exit_at

SELECT sim_metadata->>'team_id' AS team, ROUND(SUM(pnl_usd)::numeric, 2) AS net_pnl, COUNT(*) AS n FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='teamfollow' AND sim_metadata->>'team_id' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_pnl DESC

WITH liq AS (SELECT (sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::float AS l FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='teamfollow' AND sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd' IS NOT NULL) SELECT CASE WHEN l < 50000 THEN '<50k' WHEN l < 100000 THEN '50-100k' WHEN l < 250000 THEN '100-250k' WHEN l < 1000000 THEN '250k-1M' ELSE '1M+' END AS bucket, MIN(l) AS sort_key, COUNT(*) AS count FROM liq GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sort_key

SELECT id, asset, venue AS chain, sim_metadata->>'team_id' AS team, sim_metadata->>'cluster_size' AS members, entry_price, size_usd, ROUND((sim_metadata->>'peak_pct_since_entry')::numeric, 1) AS peak_pct, ROUND((sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::numeric, 0) AS entry_liq, entry_at FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='open' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='teamfollow' ORDER BY entry_at DESC

SELECT id, asset, sim_metadata->>'team_id' AS team, sim_metadata->>'cluster_size' AS members, entry_price, exit_price, size_usd, ROUND(pnl_pct::numeric, 2) AS pnl_pct, ROUND(pnl_usd::numeric, 2) AS pnl_usd, exit_reason, ROUND((sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::numeric, 0) AS entry_liq, entry_at, exit_at FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='teamfollow' ORDER BY exit_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50

SELECT halted_at, halt_type, severity, LEFT(reason, 100) AS reason, resumed_at, resumed_by FROM halts WHERE bot_id='copy_teamfollow' AND halted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' ORDER BY halted_at DESC
